# testdata/

Golden logs with license notices and expected records (SPEC B1.2).

| Directory | Contents | License and provenance |
|---|---|---|
| `pyulog/` | `sample.ulg`, the sample ULog shipped in the PX4 pyulog repository | BSD-3-Clause; see `pyulog/NOTICE.md` and `pyulog/LICENSE.md` |
| `sitl/v1.17.0/` | Multicopter (two flights with no configuration change), standard VTOL with transitions, a standard VTOL quadchute (fixed wing straight to multicopter), and failsafe flights, generated in PX4 v1.17.0 SITL (SIH). Also: a quad tailsitter with both transitions (`gz_quadtailsitter_transition`) and a multicopter with external vision odometry (`gz_x500_vision_hover`), generated in PX4 v1.17.0 SITL with Gazebo Harmonic; a multicopter that receives payload commands from two MAVLink sources (`payload_two_sources`, SIH) | Generated for this project; each log has a `.provenance.md` with the PX4 commit, airframe, simulator, and the exact command sequence |
| `sitl/v1.14.4/` | One multicopter flight generated in PX4 v1.14.4 SITL (SIH), the oldest supported schema | Same as above |
| `synthetic/` | `r4_quadchute_on_disarm.ulg`: a crafted VTOL log for the R4 window (a quadchute on the disarming sample, and one after disarm). `custom_detection.ulg`: a multicopter log with a topic PX4 does not define, for sealed topics | Written by `scripts/testdata/make_synthetic_logs.py`; see each `.provenance.md` |
| `expected/` | Reviewed expected configuration, events, and results per log | Generated by `sfr` from the logs above |
| `baselines/`, `rules/` | The baseline each golden log is sealed against (its own initial parameters, `scripts/testdata/make_baseline.py`), and, where a log needs more than `examples/rules.default.toml`, its own rules file (the default rules plus, for example, `[sealed_topics]` or `[authorized_sources]`) | Written for this project |

Rules: never add a log uploaded by a third party to Flight Review. Every log carries its license or provenance file. A log is never edited after it is added; a new scenario is a new file.
